text_block_list.text:
After seeing Нарита Таисин off to her
prerace
weigh-in on the day of the
Arima Kinen, I sit
alone in the waiting
room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me... Would you happen to
be Narita
Taishin's Тренер?

Pleased to meet you. I'm Taishin's
mother.
text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother

text_block_list.text:
An older Umamusume who's the spitting
image of
Нарита Таисин bows to me while
I stare at her in
shock.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Once my surprise wears off, we chat
together for
a little.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She explains that while most racers are
born in
spring, Нарита Таисин was born
very late, which
could be why she's so
petite.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Because of this, her mother was never
able to
properly cheer her on due to her
fear that Narita
Taishin might get injured
in a race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yet Taishin insisted on racing. And one
day when
her mother apologized to her
for her small
stature, Taishin became
furious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин's mother proceeds to hand
me a
bouquet of flowers and asks me to
give it to her
daughter.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Please don't tell her who they're from.
She won't
accept them if she knows I'm
the one giving them
to her.
text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Still, I wanted to give her all my support
in
today's race. It's the least I can do.
text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother

text_block_list.text: I'm back.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Huh? What's with the flowers?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Th-they're from a fan! It's for good luck!

text_block_list.text: Uh-huh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Do you two take me for an idiot? And by
"you
two," I mean you and my mom.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Remember how I told you that my family
runs a
business? Well, they run a flower
shop.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I can tell where these are from just by
looking at
how they're wrapped.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Whatever. It doesn't matter if my mom's
watching
or not.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I run for me and nobody else.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: All I gotta do is run and win.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
